sentences.span: The 10-year yield broke 4.40% on Friday for the first time since May.
sentences.why: Exact match on figure, direction, and timing.

sentences.span: We think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold
sentences.why: This is J.P. Morgan's own framing ("we" in a JPM Rates Strategy note), correctly attributed to JPMorgan.

sentences.span: We recommend paying 5s30s at 62bp with a stop at 48bp.
sentences.why: The 5s30s pay recommendation at 62bp/48bp stop belongs to J.P. Morgan (the note's own "we"), not Citi. Citi is described separately in the source as calling the break a positioning flush and expecting 4.40% to hold, with no trade recommendation attributed to it. Attribution swapped to the wrong bank.
Goldman is never mentioned in the source. No 4.75% year-end target or foreign-demand rationale appears anywhere in the text.

sentences.span: A hot core PCE print on Thursday (consensus 0.3% m/m) would validate our steepener
sentences.why: Print day, consensus figure, and its role as the catalyst for the steepener view all match.
